summary: Scripts are well-structured with proper error handling, module isolation, and type validation. CRITICAL flaw: workflow lines 54-55 hardcode `fail-fast: false` and `max-parallel: 2` instead of using generated outputs `needs.generate-matrix.outputs.fail-fast` and `needs.generate-matrix.outputs.max-parallel`. This defeats the core purpose of the generate-matrix job. MatrixGenerator.psm1 also lacks `$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'` at module scope (best practice for PS modules).
